notes.title: Play now part 2: Markus Ritter - Ghosts Of The Past
notes.notes: Our next installment: Markus Ritter - Ghosts Of The Past is out now! Help Markus get his life together. We worked on it for over two years and hope you enjoy it! <3

notes.title: Sequel!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Quality of Life
notes.notes: We fixed a few bugs and mistakes, but most importantly we added a hint feature which you can turn off and on to highlight some of the more important interactionpoints in the game.

notes.title: Twitch Stream - Producer Talk
notes.notes:
We gonna talk a lil bit in the beginning, will play Markus Ritter together live and talk about the events and fun facts. Afterwards we will continue to Gabriel Knight 2 and maybe Phantasmagoria if we are fast enough ;) 

Come and join us at 9am (CEST) on: [url=http://www.twitch.tv/isakucosplay]Twitch Isaku Cosplay[/url]

notes.title: Kickstarter is now live!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing! It has been a real pleasure to see the reactions to our little project!
BUT
"Markus Ritter - The Lost Family" was just the introduction, the first chapter of this game series!
With "Markus Ritter - The Ghosts of the Past" we want to start the real journey of Markus. 

For that we have launched a kickstarter campaign and hope that we can manage to hit the goal to finance the next installment! 

We want to thank you all so much again for playing the game and your feedback! 
We try our best and want to improve us and show you our plans we have with Markus and his friends. 


https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/markusritter/markus-ritter-ghosts-of-the-past/
